name: Kosd (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of turquoise over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kosd: a crowned white and green shield with a bunch of grapes and a bird, within a brown frame inscribed KOSD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kosd arms with crown and frame
